Mcdonalds (MCD) Position Upped by Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management Company; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Rose, Fjarde Ap-Fonden Fourth Swedish National Pension Fund Has Lifted Position
June 4, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Fjarde Ap-Fonden Fourth Swedish National Pension Fund increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.17% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fjarde Ap-Fonden Fourth Swedish National Pension Fund bought 2,502 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.45 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $243.96M, up from 1.45 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fjarde Ap-Fonden Fourth Swedish National Pension Fund who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
